{{Rarity|Secret}} <span style="color:#FF0000;">'''Portals'''</span>

{{Rarity|Secret}} <span style="color:#FF0000;">'''Portals'''</span> are limited time portals that drop Special {{RarityColor|Mythic|Units}}. They hold up to 6 players.
